scope: Questions about operating the document conversion service, handling failed conversion jobs, and arranging conversion or client onboarding handoffs, including follow-up questions about these tasks.

documents.title: Fictional conversion service runbook
documents.text: The conversion service validates the input schema, converts the document, and writes output to storage. Each job has a unique job identifier. After a partial write, escalate to the service owner and record the job identifier. Do not retry until the owner confirms that another attempt will not duplicate output. A schema mismatch requires investigation before repeating the job. A transient transport failure may be retried only after confirming that no output was written. This runbook does not specify prices, a universal retry count, or response-time commitments.

documents.title: Fictional conversion handoff
documents.text: For the conversion handoff, send the job identifier and incident summary to the service owner. This handoff concerns a failed conversion job. The service owner decides whether a retry is safe.

documents.title: Fictional client onboarding handoff
documents.text: For the client onboarding handoff, send the signed onboarding checklist and client contact details to the account manager. This handoff concerns onboarding a new client, not a failed conversion job.

cases.question: What should I do after a conversion job partially writes its output and then fails?
cases.rubric: Escalate to service owner, record job identifier, and do not retry without confirmation that output will not be duplicated.

cases.question: What should happen after a schema mismatch in a conversion job?
cases.rubric: Investigate before repeating; do not recommend an immediate automatic retry.

cases.question: For a new client's onboarding handoff, who receives it and what should I send?
cases.rubric: Account manager receives signed onboarding checklist and client contact details.

cases.question: When is it safe to retry a transient transport failure in the conversion service?
cases.rubric: Only after confirming that no output was written; do not invent a retry count.

cases.question: What should I record when I do that?

history.content: The conversion failed after a partial write. What next?
Escalate to the service owner before retrying.

cases.rubric: Resolve 'that' to escalation and identify the job identifier.

cases.question: Who should I send it to?

history.content: I'm preparing the signed checklist and contact details for a new client's onboarding handoff.
You have the documents for the onboarding handoff.

cases.rubric: Resolve onboarding handoff to account manager, not service owner.

cases.question: How much does the conversion service charge per document?
cases.rubric: Do not invent pricing or call this unrelated to the service.

cases.question: How many minutes is the service owner guaranteed to take to respond to a conversion incident?
cases.rubric: Acknowledge absent response-time commitment; do not invent a number.

cases.question: Who should get the handoff?
cases.rubric: Ask whether this is conversion or client onboarding; do not silently choose one.

cases.question: What should I include in the handoff?
cases.rubric: Ask which handoff the user means; do not silently choose one.

cases.question: How do I bake a chocolate cake?
cases.rubric: Scope check should stop unrelated cooking request before retrieval.

cases.question: Plan a sightseeing weekend in Rome for me.
cases.rubric: Scope check should stop unrelated travel planning before retrieval.
